rules: Repair history is append-only. New events are added; earlier events are not rewritten to make current state cleaner.
One transaction_id represents one failed-receipt lineage. A changed repaired subject remains in the same transaction lineage but always has a new exact SHA.
TRANSACTION_OPENED is idempotent by transaction_id plus receipt_id; conflicting duplicate lineage fails closed.
Only REPAIRABLE_SUBJECT transactions may emit changed-SHA replacement tickets.
A replacement ticket requires deterministic prequalification PASS on the exact replacement SHA and preserves qualification_id, workstream_id, root failed receipt and immediate failed-subject lineage.
Every replacement A-01 invocation carries the existing repair transaction_id separately from the ordinary return ticket so rerun evidence cannot create a disconnected second repair transaction.
An authoritative replacement A-01 PASS closes the existing transaction and preserves all prior failed-subject events; it never rewrites the original failure.

A replacement SUBJECT_FAILURE consumes the current candidate repair attempt. If budget remains, the same transaction is re-dispatched against the newly failed exact subject; otherwise it is dead-lettered.
A replacement INFRA_FAILURE may emit at most one same-SHA retry ticket without consuming another product repair attempt; repeated infrastructure failure dead-letters the transaction for owner review.
Admission, dependency, control-plane and non-automatable outcomes remain in the same transaction with truthful route state and never become product PASS.
Receipt-less rerun attempts may be recorded only for infrastructure/control-plane failures and must never be labeled as authoritative A-01 receipts.
Repair events and owner inbox state are routing/control evidence only; only an authoritative A-01 receipt can supply A-01 PASS evidence.
Human, author, private-data, native-platform and external-authority routes do not emit automated product replacement tickets.
The System State Reconciler may derive current repair standing from event history, current ticket pointers and owner inbox projections.
